claim: The free-Majorana genus-two even-characteristic carrier has exact T1 and S1 monomial actions. Absolute generator phases depend on a common anomaly trivialization, but relative fixed-sector and cycle-product ratios survive both diagonal sector rephasing and a common generator phase.

convention.characteristic: (a1,a2;b1,b2) with binary entries and parity a1*b1+a2*b2 mod 2
convention.T1Exponent: a1, so the phase is zeta8^a1
convention.scope: reduced theta-characteristic multiplier; the common modular-weight/anomaly factor is not fixed

invariance.diagonalSectorRephasing: Closed-cycle phase sums and fixed-sector exponents are unchanged.
invariance.commonGeneratorPhase: For a fixed phase f and two-cycle product c, 2*f-c mod 8 is unchanged; ratios between fixed sectors are also unchanged.
invariance.T1RobustTarget: Every fixed-sector-square / two-cycle-product ratio is zeta8^2 = i.
S1RobustTargets: odd-odd fixed / even-even fixed = zeta8^2 = i
odd-odd fixed squared / two-cycle product = zeta8^4 = -1

sourceBoundary.freeMajorana: complete for the declared reduced T1/S1 characteristic actions
sourceBoundary.missingDatum: genus-two fermionic Baby-Monster spin-sector amplitudes and their source-derived anomaly-line trivialization
